description: Defect A (HIGHEST PRIORITY): the 0004 migration DROPs denials while appeal_cases holds an immediate FK and foreign_keys is ON, risking data loss / FK violation on a populated DB. Make the denial-table rebuild safe for both empty AND populated DBs using the SQLite safe-rebuild pattern, and add a semantic data migration (derive deadlineStatus into legacy classification JSON; mark legacy submitted rows). Independent of other FEATs; it is the migration/runner foundation and must land first.
steps: Read server/db/migrations.ts and server/db/index.ts first. Note: runMigrations() wraps all pending migrations in ONE transaction and openDb() sets PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON before migrations. SQLite cannot toggle foreign_keys inside a transaction.

Correct migration 0004_nullable_denial_date in server/db/migrations.ts to the SQLite safe-rebuild order (ref sqlite.org/lang_altertable.html 12-step and lang_droptable.html): create denials_new with denial_date nullable, INSERT SELECT, DROP TABLE denials, ALTER denials_new RENAME TO denials, recreate the idx_denials_external_ref index. Treat 0004 as not-yet-applied in any real DB, so this is a corrected FORWARD migration. Add a comment documenting WHY the approach (foreign_key_check gate + legacy_alter_table around RENAME) is safe for both empty and populated DBs.

Harden runMigrations() in server/db/index.ts so the destructive rebuild is safe under foreign_keys=ON: enable PRAGMA legacy_alter_table=ON around the migration run so RENAME does not rewrite child FK references, and after the pending-migrations block (still inside/around the transaction) run PRAGMA foreign_key_check and throw (forcing ROLLBACK) if it returns any rows, committing only when it passes. Keep MIGRATIONS[0] (schema_migrations create) running first as today, and preserve idempotency (already-applied ids skipped via schema_migrations). Restore any PRAGMA you changed afterward.

Add migration 0005_backfill_semantics to server/db/migrations.ts: for each appeal_cases row whose classification JSON lacks a deadlineStatus key, derive it (calculated when appealDeadline present, else unknown_missing_date) and write it back; and mark legacy 'submitted' rows that have no submission_receipt_enc / handoff_version evidence appropriately (e.g. a legacy-submitted marker or move to a defined state per the review) without fabricating a receipt. Implement data-dependent backfill in TS within runMigrations if pure SQL JSON editing is impractical, keeping it idempotent and inside the gated transaction.

Add a regression test to server/db/db.test.ts that programmatically builds a synthetic 'c11' fixture DB representing the PARENT commit's pre-hardening schema/state using openRawDb() and raw SQL: patients, claims, denials with denial_date NOT NULL and real rows, appeal_cases with legacy classification JSON missing deadlineStatus and a FK to denials, and at least one legacy 'submitted' appeal_case. Then run runMigrations(db) through all migrations.

In that test assert: appeal_cases and denials row counts are unchanged (no data lost), PRAGMA foreign_key_check returns an empty result, the previously-legacy classification JSON now contains a deadlineStatus, and the legacy submitted row was handled per the 0005 rule. The fixture must be built in-test (NOT a committed binary). Do NOT touch any real DB file.
acceptance_criteria: Opening/upgrading a populated pre-hardening (c11) DB through all migrations loses no denials or appeal_cases rows and passes PRAGMA foreign_key_check.
Migrations remain idempotent: a second runMigrations on the same DB applies nothing.
Legacy classification JSON gains deadlineStatus and legacy submitted rows are handled by 0005.
Empty-DB migration still works (existing db.test.ts migration tests stay green).
The c11 fixture is constructed programmatically in a *.test.ts, not committed as a binary.
verification: npx vitest run server/db  (new c11 fixture test + existing migration/crypto tests pass)
findings:
Implemented in server/db/migrations.ts and server/db/index.ts.

MIGRATION RUNNER CONTRACT (important for later FEATs): runMigrations() now wraps the pending-migration batch between `PRAGMA legacy_alter_table=ON` + `PRAGMA foreign_keys=OFF` (set BEFORE the transaction — SQLite ignores foreign_keys changes inside an active transaction) and restores both in a finally block (legacy_alter_table=OFF, foreign_keys=ON). foreign_keys is ALWAYS left ON after runMigrations regardless of prior state, matching openDb/openTestDb/openRawDb which set it ON. A `PRAGMA foreign_key_check` runs INSIDE the transaction after applying pending migrations (only when newlyApplied.length>0) and throws -> ROLLBACK on any violation, so a populated DB is never left broken. Any new destructive table rebuild migration is therefore automatically FK-safe; just add it to MIGRATIONS.

0004_nullable_denial_date: corrected to the full SQLite safe-rebuild (create denials_new with denial_date nullable, INSERT SELECT, DROP denials, RENAME, recreate idx_denials_external_ref). Treated as a corrected FORWARD migration (never applied in any real DB).

0005_backfill_semantics: SQL is empty; its effect is runBackfill0005(db) exported from migrations.ts and invoked by runMigrations inside the gated transaction. It (1) adds deadlineStatus to legacy classification JSON ONLY when the key is absent — 'calculated' iff the row already has a truthy appealDeadline, else 'unknown_missing_date' (no fabrication); and (2) demotes legacy state='submitted' rows whose submission_receipt_enc IS NULL to 'handoff_generated' (a defined OPEN_FOR_DEADLINE state that keeps urgency open; no receipt fabricated). Both operations are idempotent. NOTE for later FEATs: runBackfill0005 depends on the submission_receipt_enc column (added by 0003), which is guaranteed because 0003 runs earlier in the same batch or is already applied.

TEST: server/db/db.test.ts gained a 'c11 pre-hardening upgrade' describe block. buildC11Db() constructs the parent-commit schema (0001+0002 only: denials.denial_date NOT NULL, appeal_cases without 0003 columns) IN-MEMORY via openRawDb()+raw SQL (no committed binary), marks 0001/0002 applied, seeds 2 denials + 2 appeal_cases (one legacy 'submitted' w/o receipt, legacy classification JSON missing deadlineStatus), then runs all migrations. Asserts: row counts unchanged, PRAGMA foreign_key_check empty, denial_date now nullable (table_info notnull=0), case_1 deadlineStatus='calculated', case_2 deadlineStatus='unknown_missing_date', case_2 state demoted to 'handoff_generated', and idempotency (second runMigrations returns []).

VERIFICATION (L3/L2, Node v24.21.0): `npx vitest run server/db` = 11 passed; `npm run typecheck` clean; `npm test` = 135 passed | 1 skipped (baseline 133|1 + 2 new c11 tests, no regressions). No existing tests weakened or deleted. No real DB touched.
